summary: The prepared base reproduced the original mixed-stream decoder defect exactly. At the exact candidate commit, the exported BlockStoredView and KVEventBatchView decoded legacy unsalted and salted producer payloads in one stream while preserving cache_salt, leaving producer bytes unchanged. Focused regression, independent adversarial wire cases, imports, and pre-commit checks passed.

tests.what_was_measured: On base commit 358c1632, reproduced the exact 7/8-element mixed wire shapes, silent cache_salt loss through KVEventBatch, rejection of the unsalted event by BlockStoredWithMetadata, and duplicate-tag union construction failure.
At candidate a029c210, 16 tests and 22 subtests passed, including the candidate mixed producer-payload regression and existing KV-event behavior.

Independent msgpack tests covered mixed salted/unsalted stores, BlockRemoved and AllBlocksCleared in the same batch, attn_dp_rank retention, exact legacy bytes, explicit null metadata, unknown future metadata keys, malformed metadata rejection, boundary-like integer values, Unicode/NUL salt content, unchanged producer bytes, and the documented decode-only encoding caveat.
